description: Figure 5 is a grouped bar chart that displays the proportion, as a percentage, of incorrectly answered samples in which the co-occurrence popularity of the generated entity (RPop_Ge) is less than that of the ground-truth entity (RPop_GT). The horizontal axis categorizes the data into three domains: “Movies,” “Songs,” and “Basketball.” The vertical axis, labeled “Ratio (%)”, ranges from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. For each domain, three bars represent the performance of different large language models: Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow). In the “Movies” category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both show a ratio of approximately 90%, while ChatGPT is lower at about 73%. In “Songs,” Llama3 is at approximately 84%, Qwen2 at 90%, and ChatGPT at about 63%. In “Basketball,” Llama3 is at roughly 67%, Qwen2 at 57%, and ChatGPT at approximately 62%. The chart visually indicates that for all models, the proportion of incorrect answers where RPop_Ge < RPop_GT is highest in the “Movies” domain and lowest in “Basketball,” with Qwen2 consistently showing the highest or near-highest ratio across all domains.
